content:
[0:00–0:02] Low-angle wide shot: A bullet blasts through the cowboy’s hat as he charges through the desert on horseback.

[0:02–0:04] Over-the-shoulder shot: He spins and fires behind him at three masked riders closing in fast.

[0:04–0:06] Tracking side shot: He kicks his horse harder and races into a narrow canyon.

[0:06–0:08] Front low-angle shot: The horse charges straight at camera as bullets whip past from behind.

[0:08–0:10] Close-up: The cowboy reloads fast, eyes locked forward, jaw tense.

[0:10–0:12] Rear chase shot: He fires back and hits the lead rider’s shoulder, sending him flying off his horse.

[0:12–0:14] Top-down shot: The remaining riders weave through rocks and cacti, dust exploding beneath them.

[0:14–0:16] Side tracking shot: The cowboy shoots a hanging lantern on a wagon, triggering a fiery blast behind him.

[0:16–0:18] Wide shot: One outlaw’s horse panics at the explosion and crashes into the wagon, flipping it over.

[0:18–0:20] Low-angle chase shot: The last rider pushes through the smoke and pulls up beside him, firing point-blank.

[0:20–0:22] Extreme close-up: The cowboy ducks, fires upward, and knocks the outlaw’s gun out of his hand.

[0:22–0:24] Dutch-angle shot: He swerves hard around a falling rock as the outlaw gets hit by the collapse and goes down.

[0:24–0:26] Wide shot: The canyon fills with dust, debris, and scattered horses as the chase breaks apart behind him.

[0:26–0:28] Front tracking shot: He glances back, sees no one left on his tail, and drives his horse into a final sprint.

[0:28–0:30] Epic wide shot: He bursts out of the canyon alone and disappears into the moonlit desert.

NO MUSIC / NO MUSIC under any circumstances.
